scope: Bound explicit native Box edits in original PPTX frames; shared DrawingML group math and bounded source DOMs

implementation.shared_math: Existing reader matrix/group computations moved to ooxml.pptx_transforms without changing equations
implementation.projection: Invert preserved parent frame and absolute axis-aligned bounds to native off/ext/rot; reject singular, ambiguous or unrepresentable requests
implementation.frames: Figures, pictures and unconnected connectors support position/size/rotation; GraphicFrame supports translation only
implementation.precision: At most one slide-coordinate EMU per x/y/width/height and half a native angular unit; amplification by group scale checked by forward projection after native integer quantization
implementation.neighbors: Original parent frames and all unchanged native payloads retained; text and geometry share one DOM to avoid overwriting each other
implementation.bindings: Version 2 masks verified native Box frames; version 1 retains the existing text-only contract
implementation.decoder_budget: Source DOM element/depth/characters budget shared across slide roots; comments and processing instructions counted before lxml DOM allocation; legacy Anatomy element-inventory semantics unchanged

tests.corpus: Ordinary/rotated/flipped/nested/nonuniform groups, figures/images/free lines, table movement, simultaneous text and Box edits, two JSON/PPTX cycles with canonical native XML and unchanged other payload bytes
tests.negative: Ambiguous 45-degree resize, table grid resize, connected endpoints, native mirrored reframe outside precision, malformed source XML quotas including comments/PI; old file and Model retained
tests.regression_command: python -m pytest tests/readers tests/writers tests/support/test_ooxml_pptx_package.py tests/support/test_ooxml_package.py -k 'pptx or office_export_cancellation or ooxml_package' -q --tb=short
tests.large_pptx_scope: Own 35-slide/6720-run fixture, selected budgets, public JSON, inspection/export and unchanged source
tests.installed_wheel: Passed: pptx-only profile without fontTools/DOCX/PDF/bs4, native text plus position/width/rotation edit, only source slide XML changed

independent_powerpoint.source: Own grouped textbox with 25-degree, nonuniform parent transform; separate nested reflected source for refusal
independent_powerpoint.procedure: Edit child Left/Top/Width/Height/Rotation through PowerPoint; save native PPTX/PDF; import resulting Box and apply it to original source through Formats; render library PPTX separately in PowerPoint
independent_powerpoint.source_opening: Read-only, macros disabled, no attachment to a running PowerPoint app
independent_powerpoint.equality_policy: Within each renderer; no universal pixel-identity claim for geometry
independent_powerpoint.nested_reflected_case: PowerPoint normalized its group; target Box not representable in preserved original frames within one slide EMU; Formats refused instead of silently drifting

remaining: Controlled parent-frame normalization while preserving every child and paint/text semantics
Inherited placeholder geometry and ambiguous local extents outside the finite profile
Connected endpoint projection and table/chart grid/row resizing
Native styles/notes/content/structure edits, complete signature and ZIP metadata acceptance
Broader independent originals and native PowerPoint rendering/editing corpus; this finite acceptance is not full C-PPTX-01
